raw_segments.text: Eight, zero, three a half, mostly shanty boards, refused shingles for roof sides, four laths.
One point two five two second hand windows with glass.
Two point four three one thousand old brick.
Two point four that was high, hair.
Zero point three one more than I needed.
Three point nine hinges and screws.
One point four I carried a good part, on my back, in all.
